name: Dabeull
description: Dabeull is a visionary French producer and artist, widely regarded as a leading figure in the global funk revival. With his unmistakable blend of punchy basslines, retro synthesizers, and sensual vocals, he has carved out an unique place on the international music scene. Known for his 70s?80s movie star aesthetic and analog obsession, Dabeull channels the golden era of funk with unmatched authenticity. His sound is deeply influenced by the Pop, Funk and African Music he was exposed to during his youth, infused with the warmth of vintage gear and recorded entirely using classic 70s synthesizers. Whether in the studio or on stage, Dabeull is a master of groove. His live shows?featuring a full analog band, period costumes, and retro instrumentation?transport audiences on a nostalgic, feel-good journey through funk history.With a growing global fanbase and a distinct artistic identity, Dabeull continues to redefine modern funk while honoring its timeless roots.
